about: Gold cases for the scoring pipeline. Each case says what a careful reader should conclude: expect = items that must be found (type, allowed modes, optional allowed principles, optional maxPoints), forbid = items that must NOT appear, none = nothing at all should be scored. pairs compare total points: `more` must beat `less`.

cases.text: I gave my lunch to a hungry man outside my office today.
I really want to donate to the temple this weekend, I just have not done it yet.
My brother provoked me badly and I wanted to slap him, but I stayed calm and walked away.
I felt so jealous when my colleague got promoted. I kept thinking about it all evening.
While walking I silently wished that my neighbour's sick child gets well soon. I only thought it, I did nothing.
I spent the whole afternoon imagining how to take revenge on my neighbour.
I secretly hoped my friend would fail his exam.
I shouted at my wife in front of the kids over a small thing.
I lied to my manager that I was sick so I could skip work.
I snapped at my mother this morning. I feel really guilty and I apologised to her.
My boss insulted me in the meeting and I felt humiliated.
I went to the office, had lunch and came back home.
Had a quiet day today.
Tomorrow I plan to visit my parents and spend the whole day with them.
I wasted four hours scrolling on my phone instead of studying.
I donated money to the school but mostly so that people would praise me.
I gave 500 rupees to a poor family today.
I thought about giving 500 rupees to a poor family today but I did not.
I helped an old lady cross the road, then I lied to my teacher about my homework, and I felt envious of a friend's new bike.
આજે મેં એક ભૂખ્યા માણસને જમાડ્યો.
મને મારા પાડોશીની પ્રગતિ જોઈને બહુ ઈર્ષ્યા થઈ, આખો દિવસ એ જ વિચાર આવ્યા કર્યો.
મને ગુસ્સો ખૂબ આવ્યો પણ મેં કંઈ બોલ્યા વગર શાંત રહેવાનું પસંદ કર્યું.
કાલે હું મંદિર જઈશ અને ગરીબોને દાન કરીશ એવું મેં વિચાર્યું છે.
मैंने गुस्से में अपने भाई को गाली दी।
मेरे मन में बार-बार लालच आया कि दोस्त का पैसा रख लूँ, पर मैंने सिर्फ सोचा, किया नहीं।
आज मैंने बीमार पड़ोसी की रात भर सेवा की।
मैं सोच रहा हूँ कि अगले महीने से वृद्धाश्रम में सेवा शुरू करूँगा।

pairs.why: giving 500 rupees counts for more than only thinking of it
a deed counts for more than an intention
a sincere gift outscores one given for praise
